# lamejs 1.2.1

`lame.min.js` is the unmodified browser build of
[lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) 1.2.1 (npm `lamejs`), a JavaScript
port of the [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io/) MP3 encoder. It is licensed
under the LGPL 3.0 (see `LICENSE`, LAME's note on using it) and is loaded as a
separate file by `src/mp3-worker.js`, which turns takes into MP3 files for
saving. It is not modified here; to update it, replace the file with a newer
release's `lame.min.js`.
